prides.name: Mhangeni Pride
aliases: Mhangeni Breakaway (original form, 2010-2013; Tsalala Breakaway sub-adults)
prides.status: Active (west of Londolozi, rarely seen on the property by 2024-26). Feb 2026: three adult lionesses (two born 2016 sired by Majingilane; one born 2018 sired by Birmingham) plus three Plains-Camp-sired subadults and four cubs born Nov 2025. Jul 2026: one experienced lioness with three ~2.5-year-old subadults seen hunting wildebeest.
prides.origin_summary: Breakaway from the Tsalala Pride at the Majingilane takeover (2010). Founded by four young lionesses born 2009 (one post says 2008) to the Tsalala Sisters and sired by the Mapogo Males; when the Majingilane killed several Tsalala cubs the Original Tailless Female (their grandmother) led the surviving four sub-adults north and raised them to independence (c.18 months); on her return in Oct 2011 the Tsalala Sisters rejected them and the four became a separate pride, named Mhangeni (c.2012-13). Dates of formation vary between posts (2010, Jan 2012, 2013).

splits_and_takeovers.event: Pride described as originating from a breakaway of the Tsalala Pride six years earlier (2010) when the Majingilane arrived.
Four 2009-born sub-adult females lose connection with Original Tailless Female in Jan 2012 after the flood and form the Mhangeni Pride; the Original Tailless Female rejoins Tsalala.
2013: Original Tailless Female (aged ~15) is mauled by the Mhangeni females at a zebra carcass and found dead at Marthly Pools (2018-05-20 post says only 'suspected').
First Mhangeni litter (2013): 9 cubs raised to independence under Majingilane protection (a tenth cub disappeared early).
Sept 2015: a clash with rival lions in the north splits the 13-strong pride (4 adult females, 9 sub-adults); a young Sparta male later joins them (14 counted 12 Sep 2015).
Aug 2016: the nine sub-adults (the 'Mhangeni breakaways') briefly rejoin the four mothers, a 'super pride' of 22.

29 Apr 2017: Mhangeni Breakaway Pride (six sister lionesses) permanently split from the Mhangeni females and renamed the Ntsevu Pride; the three brothers had left a few months earlier (Dec 2016 post).
Nov 2017: pride still large (13 lions drinking + 3 females + a Majingilane male = 17 counted).
2018: second batch of 12 sub-adults (9M/3F) pushed out end of 2017, some died; pride reduced to 3 adult lionesses + 1 sub-adult; new litter of 4 cubs mid-2018.
Dec 2019: Othawa Male joins the Mhangeni pride and becomes its protector.
2021: Othawa Male dies; pride left without a male; Plains Camp Males move into the western territory.

2022: one original (2009-born) Mhangeni lioness breaks away to mate with Plains Camp Males, loses the pride and temporarily pairs with the lone Tsalala Female (~Aug-Sep 2022); rejoins pride by Nov 2022 apparently pregnant.
2023: Plains Camp Males dominant over Mhangeni and Ximungwe Prides and siring nine cubs with the Mhangeni.
Jun 2024: pride = 5 lionesses + 10 cubs under Plains Camp Males; two original lionesses (b.2009, aged 15) still alive, one toothless.
2024: Mhangeni pride presumed to have killed the two Nkuhuma Breakaway lionesses (Ridge Nose and Amber Eyes).
2025-26: Plains Camp Males move north; Nkumati Coalition (Nkuhuma + Talamati males) takes over mating rights; one 2018-born lioness has 4 cubs (Nov 2025).

prides.notes: Contradictions: (1) founders' birth year 2009 (most posts) vs 2008 ('eleven years old' in 2019-12-02). (2) Fathers: first cubs of the original four were Mapogo-sired; later litters Majingilane (2013, 2015/16), Birmingham (2018), Othawa (2020-21), Plains Camp (2023), Nkumati (2025). (3) The 2013 litter 'split to form Ntsevu in 2015' (2024-06-10) vs renamed April 2017 (2017-04-29). (4) 2024-06-10 lists five lionesses incl. two born 2009, but 2026-02-12 lists only three adults (b.2016 x2, b.2018) - fate of the two originals not stated. (5) 2022-08-10 composition: two older original lionesses, two from the 2015/16 litter of 12, one from the 2018 litter, one 2021 Othawa cub.

prides.name: Mhangeni Breakaway Pride / Ntsevu Pride (origin only)
prides.status: Covered in detail by another agent. Renamed Ntsevu Pride on 2017-04-29; split in 2021-24 into Ntsevu Pride (3 original lionesses) and Kambula Pride (name used by Mala Mala; adopted 2024-03-21).
prides.origin_summary: Six young lionesses (plus three brothers) from the first Mhangeni litter (2013, sired by Majingilane) who split from the original Mhangeni mothers in 2016 when the mothers began breeding again; named Ntsevu (Shangaan 'six') 29 Apr 2017.

splits_and_takeovers.event: Oct 2016: six breakaway lionesses, two pregnant, unlikely to regroup with the mothers; compared to the 2010-13 formation of Mhangeni from Tsalala.
Renamed the Ntsevu Pride.
Late Mar 2017: six Mhangeni breakaway lionesses kill a Sparta lioness.
2024: Ntsevu/Kambula naming split formalised after Ndzhenga takeover.

prides.notes: Stub for lineage linking only; see Ntsevu/Kambula agent for details.

prides.name: Nkuhuma Pride
prides.status: Active, northern Sabi Sand / Marthly / Manyeleti. Fractured into factions (3 in Aug 2022, 23 lions). Mid-2024: four adult females, three sub-adult females, one sub-adult male. 2026: Ndzhenga Males pursuing/siring with the pride in the north (inferred).
prides.origin_summary: Originates north of Londolozi ('Nkuhuma is the Shangaan name for Brown Ivory Tree'). Talamati Pride broke away from it in 2007. Named matriarchs include littermates Ridge Nose and Amber Eyes (born Dec 2012, sired by Matimba Males). Moved onto Marthly (northern Londolozi) as the Tsalala Pride dwindled - first seen there Jan 2020 per 2020-03-05, but 2022-08-10 says 'we began to see them on Marthly in 2018'.

splits_and_takeovers.event: Jan 2020: 16 lions (6 females, 9 cubs, 1 Northern Avoca male) first seen on Marthly; cubs sired by Northern Avoca Males.
Aug 2020: 8 lionesses + 9 cubs with Avoca males 'often in tow'.
Aug 2022: three factions (23 lions): (1) two Dec-2012 littermates with Plains-Camp cubs, (2) two adults + seven 2019 subadults (5M/2F), (3) three mid-2016 females + seven 2021 subadults (3M/4F).

Two Dec-2012 lionesses (Ridge Nose, Amber Eyes) had broken away west and mated with Plains Camp Males ('Nkuhuma Breakaway Pride'); both later killed, presumably by Mhangeni pride; their two cubs (b.2022) survived.
Jul 2024: Plains Camp Males encroaching on pride after Black Dam Males left and Northern Avoca Male aged.
Sep 2024: Ntsevu Breakaway Males move to Manyeleti and mate with Nkuhuma lionesses.

prides.notes: Several posts use 'Nkuhuma Breakaway' for different things: (a) Mar 2022 'Nkuhuma Breakaway pride' with Avoca males (2022-03-31), (b) the two Dec-2012 lionesses who left to the west, (c) their two surviving offspring, the 'Nkuhuma Breakaways' (young male and female, b.2022). Pride size reported as 16 (Jan 2020), 17 (Aug 2020), 23 (Aug 2022).

prides.name: Nkuhuma Breakaway Pride
prides.status: Pride of two: a young male and female (born 2022, sired by Plains Camp Males), orphaned after their mothers were killed in early-mid 2024. Roaming nomadically in western/northern Londolozi; male began roaming south-east in mid-2025 and was involved in a fight with the blonde Gijima Male in 2026.
prides.origin_summary: Two adult Nkuhuma lionesses (Ridge Nose and Amber Eyes, born Dec 2012, sired by Matimba Males) broke away westward after the Ndzhenga/Plains Camp arrivals and mated with Plains Camp Males; one raised two cubs (1M, 1F) born 2022.

splits_and_takeovers.event: Both adult lionesses killed 'presumably by the Mhangeni Pride'; two ~2.5-year-old cubs left to fend for themselves.
Young male ranging further east/south; sister may separate as she nears maturity.
Male (b.2022) confronts and injures the blonde Gijima Male; moving with his sister.

prides.name: Talamati Pride
prides.status: Active but without fixed territory in 2023; 2023: five lionesses (oldest 'Silver-eye', ~15 yrs in 2022, plus four ~5-year-olds) and two young males who had separated from the pride. Related 'Talamati Breakaway Pride' = Msuthlu Pride (2025).
prides.origin_summary: Broke away from the Nkuhuma Pride in 2007 when the Mapogo took over from the Manyeleti Males; initially the Nkuhuma Breakaway Pride, taken over by the 'Old Nkuhuma Males' who sired two females (incl. the one-eyed 'Silver-eye'); dispersed to Kruger NP in 2008 with those males; named after Talamati Bushveld Camp in 2011; returned to the Sabi Sands in 2011.

splits_and_takeovers.event: Succession of coalitions: Matimba Males (2011-2015) -> Selati Males (2015) -> Northern Avoca Males (2019); Matimba and Selati daughters later mate with the Imbali Male (2021).
First arrival on Londolozi mid-April 2022: 8 lions (2 adult females + 2 young males + 4 young females; ninth is Dark-maned Northern Avoca male).
Aug 2023: pride has no territory of its own; four young lionesses + oldest lioness; two young males separate.
Oct 2025: 'Msuthlu Pride (formerly the Talamati Breakaway Pride)' is mentioned as returning to Londolozi with the Gijima Males.

prides.notes: first_mentioned 2016-04-02 refers to nomadic Talamati MALES only; pride first seen on Londolozi mid-Apr 2022. Talamati young male sired by Matimba Males seen with Mhangeni breakaways in 2016 (2016-08-20). In July 2022 the pride was described as 'newest pride' even though a 2016 Talamati young male was seen on Londolozi. Msuthlu Pride covered by another agent.

prides.name: Ximungwe Pride (lions)
prides.status: Western-sector pride, dominated by Plains Camp Males (2023-24); described as the 'Ximungwe (now Bateleur) Pride' in Feb 2026 with the Plains Camp Males moving north following it.
prides.origin_summary: Not stated in these posts. Named Ximungwe Pride (also leopard names Ximungwe are unrelated leopards).

splits_and_takeovers.event: Plains Camp Males described as dominant over Mhangeni and Ximungwe Prides.
Plains Camp Males have sired cubs with the Ximungwe Pride.
Altercation between Tsalala Female and the Ximugwe Pride near her den, Nov 2024.
Renamed Bateleur Pride; Plains Camp Males push north after it, leaving the south-west open to the Nkumati Coalition.

prides.notes: Not otherwise described; no individuals named.

prides.name: Msuthlu Pride (formerly Talamati Breakaway Pride) - link only
prides.status: Covered by another agent. Mid-2026: four adult females and ~7 subadults; sired by Gijima Males; some adults associating with the Nwaswitshaka Males (Sept 2026).
prides.origin_summary: 2025-10-05 states the Msuthlu Pride was formerly the Talamati Breakaway Pride. 2026-04-04 says first seen in 2022 in the north of the reserve before moving south.

splits_and_takeovers.event: Gijima Males identified as the fathers of the pride's cubs.

individuals.label: Original Tailless Female (Tsalala)
individuals.birth_note: Born 1998 (2017-05-01); 'Two and Seven' pride formed by two Castleton breakaway females in 1998 (2021-12-07). Mother died when she was ~4.
individuals.fate: Found dead at Marthly Pools in 2013 after being mauled while trying to feed at a Mhangeni pride zebra kill (2021-12-07 states Mhangeni females mauled her; 2018-05-20 says only 'suspected').
individuals.mother_id_or_label: Unnamed adult female of the 'Two and Seven' pride (died ~2002, hyenas)
offspring_labels: Tsalala Sisters (b. Dec 2002, sired by Marthly Males)
Tailless female cubs born 2005, 2008 (four, sired by Mapogo), 2012 single cub (12th cub)
individuals.notes: Lost her own tail to hyenas (2005). Took the surviving 2009-born granddaughters (daughters of the Tsalala Sisters) north in 2010-2011 and raised them to independence; these became the Mhangeni Pride. 2022-01-10: 'The Mhangeni Pride is the result of a heroic rescue of a set of cubs by their grandmother.' 2017-05-01 says the rescued cubs were 'actually her daughter's and not her own'. Primary coverage belongs to the Tsalala agent.

individuals.label: Tsalala Sisters (Tailed Female and New Tailless Female)
individuals.birth_note: Both born December 2002 on Ximpalapala Koppie to the Original Tailless Female, sired by the Marthly Males (2021-12-07).
individuals.fate: Group entry. Tailed Female died early 2018 (aged ~15, after an elephant carcass feeding); New Tailless Female died May-June 2018 after an injury attributed to the Ntsevu lionesses (Tsalala agent).
offspring_labels: Original Mhangeni lionesses (four founders, 2 each, sired by Mapogo, b. 2009)
individuals.notes: Each sister bore two female cubs in 2009 sired by the Mapogo Males, which became the four founders of the Mhangeni Pride. 2022-09-19 describes the 2009-born Mhangeni female as the Tsalala Female's great aunt.

individuals.label: Original Mhangeni lionesses (four founders)
individuals.birth_note: Born 2009 (2021-12-07, 2022-09-19, 2024-06-10); conflicting 'born in 2008, eleven years old' in 2019-12-02. Two female cubs each from the two Tsalala Sisters.
individuals.fate: Fate of the individuals not stated: 4 adults in 2015-16, 3 adults in 2018-19, two 'original' lionesses (15 yrs, one toothless) still alive Jun 2024; 2026-02-12 lists no 2009-born adult.
offspring_labels: Mhangeni 2013 litter (9 cubs; 6 became Ntsevu founding lionesses)
sibling_labels: Group entry: four sisters/cousins; Tsalala Female (b.2019) is a great-niece of one of them
individuals.notes: Four females raised by their grandmother (Original Tailless Female) after the Majingilane takeover; produced all successive Mhangeni litters. 2019-12-02: 'three' adults; 2024-06-10: 'two lionesses were born into the original Mhangeni Pride in 2009'.

individuals.label: Mhangeni lioness born 2009 who mated with Plains Camp Males (2022)
individuals.birth_note: 'This lioness was born in 2009 and is now almost 14 years old' (2022-09-19)
individuals.fate: Rejoined the Mhangeni Pride by Nov 2022, believed pregnant; later fate not stated.
individuals.notes: Left pride in mid-2022 after Plains Camp Males killed cubs not sired by them (per 2022-09-19), then paired with the lone Tsalala Female for ~2 months (Aug-Sept 2022); 2022-11-21: she fed on an impala without sharing and 'rejoined the Mhangeni Pride'. 2022-09-19: Tsalala Female's great aunt. Identity as one of the four founders is stated ('formed the core of the pride').

individuals.label: Mhangeni first litter (born 2013): 9 cubs (6 females + 3 males)
individuals.birth_note: Ntsevu females 'born in 2013' (2019-11-23); first Mhangeni batch first seen Sept 2013 with nine cubs (a tenth disappeared early).
individuals.fate: Six females became the Ntsevu Pride (renamed 2017-04-29). Three males split off Aug-Dec 2016; one Talamati male joined them in 2016. Males 'went that way' into obscurity (2018-09-06).
sibling_labels: Group entry; the 3 males were 'brothers to the Ntsevu lionesses'
individuals.notes: 9 of 10 raised to independence ('9 out of 10 on their first try (6 of which became the Ntsevu pride)' 2018-11-08). Sub-adults were pushed out as mothers began mating again. 2016-08-20: 3 young males under pressure from Matimba males; two lionesses pregnant by Oct 2016.

individuals.label: Ntsevu founding lionesses (six, formerly Mhangeni Breakaways)
individuals.fate: Link entry only; see Ntsevu agent. By 2023 two of the original six had died (2023 'unknown circumstances'); pride split into Ntsevu (3 originals) and Kambula (2024).
individuals.notes: Named Ntsevu on 2017-04-29 (Shangaan 'six'). Killed a Sparta lioness in Mar-Apr 2017 (2017-04-03). Mated with Matimba, Matshipiri, Majingilane (2017-11-06), Birmingham.

individuals.label: Mhangeni 2013 litter males (three brothers of the Ntsevu lionesses)
individuals.birth_note: 2013 litter (inferred from 'nine sub-adults ... three males, six females', 2016-08-20/2016-09-05)
individuals.fate: Split from the breakaway lionesses between Aug and Dec 2016; subsequently 'consigned to obscurity' (2018-09-06). Fate unknown.
individuals.notes: Described as under pressure from the Matimba males to leave the young females (2016-08-20). Possibly some of the males that later disappeared into Kruger; no identification made.

individuals.label: Mhangeni second big litter (late Oct 2015-mid 2016): 12 cubs (9 males, 3 females)
individuals.birth_note: Born between late October 2015 and mid-2016 (2018-09-29); the 2016-09-03 post reports '12 cubs between them' at ~age months.
individuals.fate: Pushed out by their mothers around end of 2017; fragmented, some died, some trailed the pride (2018-09-29). Two survivors are adult lionesses born 2016 (2026-02-12).
sibling_labels: Group entry; includes the two 2016-born adult females of 2026
individuals.notes: Mhangeni adults were seen mating with Birmingham males in Feb 2018 as they pushed these sub-adults away (2018-02-27). 'Mhangeni females collectively gave birth to 12 cubs' - sub-adults numbered 16 mouths with the adults.

individuals.label: Mhangeni lioness born 2018 (sired by Birmingham Males)
individuals.birth_note: 2026-02-12: 'one adult female born in 2018, sired by the Birmingham Males'. Likely from the litter of four seen Sept 2018 (inferred).
individuals.fate: Alive Feb 2026; gave birth to four cubs in Nov 2025.
individuals.notes: Cubs of Nov 2025 presumed sired by Nkumati Coalition (2026-07-07: 'The Nkumati coalition, having sired offspring with the Mhangeni pride'; the 2026-02-12 text does not name the sire explicitly). Linked to the 2018 litter by inference only.

individuals.label: Mhangeni cubs of Othawa Male's tenure (2020-21)
individuals.birth_note: Two cubs reported Aug 2020; a third cub carried by mother Dec 2020 (6-8 weeks old); 'last remaining cub from the Othawa Male's reign born in 2021' (2022-08-10). Year of birth inconsistent (2020 vs 2021).
individuals.fate: Only one survived to Aug 2022; later fate not stated.
individuals.notes: 2020-12-29 describes a pride of adult lionesses, cubs and the Othawa Male. After the Othawa Male's death (2021) the Plains Camp Males moved in and 'killed off any offspring not sired by them' (2022-09-19).

individuals.label: Mhangeni cubs sired by Plains Camp Males (2023): nine cubs; three subadults by 2026
individuals.birth_note: Nine cubs reported Sept 2023 (2023-09-04); ten cubs Jun 2024 (2024-06-10); Feb 2026: two subadult females and one subadult male (2026-02-12).
individuals.fate: Survivors by 2026: two females, one male (subadults). Jul 2026: three subadults ~2.5 yrs old hunting with one experienced lioness (2026-07-16).
individuals.notes: Hippo carcass sighting Jun 2024 with five lionesses and ten cubs. Cub counts differ between posts (9 vs 10 vs 3 survivors).

individuals.label: Mhangeni cubs born Nov 2025 (four)
individuals.birth_note: Born November 2025 to a 2018-born lioness (2026-02-12)
individuals.fate: Alive and healthy, first brought to a kill Jan 2026.
individuals.father_or_sire_label: Nkumati Coalition (Nkuhuma Male + Talamati Male) - implied
individuals.notes: The other two Mhangeni lionesses were also mating with the Nkumati males (2026-02-12). Paternity is implied, not stated outright in the Feb 2026 post; 2026-07-07 states the coalition 'sired offspring with the Mhangeni pride'.

individuals.label: Sparta young male who joined Mhangeni pride (2015)
individuals.birth_note: One of the Sparta males born 2012 (2018-09-06); pushed out with his two brothers by the Majingilane on 16 Jul 2015.
individuals.fate: Joined Mhangeni pride Sept 2015 (14th lion counted 12 Sep 2015), then 'was with them one day and the next he was not' (2018-09-06). A 2019 post recalls him 'for a few weeks' with the then Mhangeni Breakaway. Fate unknown; possibly seen near Skukuza.
individuals.notes: Earlier tried to join the Tsalala pride. Cross-agent link (Sparta).

individuals.label: Talamati young male who joined Mhangeni Breakaways (2016)
individuals.birth_note: Young male in 2016; one of three Talamati males 'pushed into independence' (2016-04-02) and separated from his brothers in a fight with the Charleston males.
individuals.fate: Travelled with the Mhangeni breakaway sub-adults Aug-Sept 2016; later fate not stated.
individuals.notes: 2016-08-20: 'the Matimba males (who are his fathers and the only reason he hasn't been driven off by them)'. Not clearly the same as the later Talamati young males (b.2019).

individuals.label: Othawa Male (also written Ottawa)
individuals.birth_note: Born early 2015 (2021-01-09: five year old Othawa male); 2018-09-17 says 3.5 yrs; 2019-12-02 inconsistently says 'about seven years old'.
individuals.fate: Died 2021. Posts say he was killed by the Birmingham Males after pushing too far east into their territory (2024-08-05, 2024-08-26); in Jun 2021 the Birmingham Males had 'triumphed over' him (2021-06-22); a deceased male is photographed by Sept 2021 (2021-09-20).
offspring_labels: Mhangeni cubs of 2020-21 (one survivor in Aug 2022)
individuals.notes: Lone male, joined Mhangeni pride Dec 2019, mated with Ntsevu lioness Mar 2020 (2020-03-24). Dominant over south-west/west Londolozi. Contradictions: age in Dec 2019; cause of death (see fate).

individuals.label: Plains Camp Male (larger)
individuals.birth_note: ~5 years old Sept 2021 (2021-09-20) => born ~2016 (inferred); 'at the age of eight years' for one male in Sept 2024 (2024-09-11)
individuals.fate: Alive as of Nov 2025 (roaring near Ximpalapala Crest). 'Possibly the largest male lion in the Sabi Sand' (2024-04-22).
individuals.notes: Scar across his eye from a clash with the Southern Avoca Male (2025-01-16). Dominant of the pair in mating (2024-04-22). An unnamed Plains Camp Male limped with a back-leg injury after Aug 2025 clashes with Gijima Males (2025-08-17).

individuals.label: Plains Camp Male (smaller, very dark mane)
individuals.birth_note: Same age as brother (~5 in 2021)
individuals.fate: Alive as of Nov 2025.
individuals.notes: 2025-01-16: 'the smaller of the two Plains Camp Males' is the possible culprit in killing the three Tsalala cubs (Nov 2024) - inferred only; neighbours say both visited the cubs without aggression (2024-11-11).

individuals.label: Nkuhuma Male (Nkumati Coalition)
individuals.birth_note: Born ~2016 (2021-01-09: ~4 years old 'born 2016'; 7 years old in Sept 2023, 8 in 2024)
individuals.fate: Alive Jul 2026 (Nkumati Coalition, south-west Londolozi). Survived Ntsevu Breakaway attack (2023) and Plains Camp/Gijima encounters (2025).
individuals.father_or_sire_label: Birmingham Males (stated 2022-08-10: 'either his son or nephew' of the last Birmingham male; 2023-09-04: 'his late father, the Birmingham Male')
individuals.notes: Left the Nkuhuma Pride and paired with the Styx young male (b.2016) by 2020-21; Styx partner 'mysteriously died'. Teamed in 2022 with the last Birmingham Male after Ndzhenga takeover; scarred right eyelid (2026-04-02), scar from altercation with his Birmingham father. Briefly paired with Skorro Male Jan 2024; formed coalition with the Talamati Male from mid/late 2024 ('together since mid-2024', 2026-02-12); named Nkumati (2026-02-09).

individuals.label: Talamati Male (Nkumati Coalition)
individuals.birth_note: One of two 'sub-adult males' among the nine cubs born early 2019 (2022-07-25) - identity with the 2024 'Talamati Male' is inferred
individuals.fate: Alive Jul 2026.
individuals.father_or_sire_label: Northern Avoca Males (stated for the 2019 litter, 2022-07-25)
sibling_labels: Talamati cohort females (4) and a 2021-dead male
individuals.notes: Stood his ground (the Nkuhuma Male fled) when the Plains Camp Males attacked the pair on 21 Jun 2025 as they mated with a Ntsevu lioness (2025-06-22). Unrelated to Nkuhuma Male ('not brothers').

individuals.label: Talamati Male (died 2024)
individuals.birth_note: As above (inferred from the two young Talamati males, 2023)
individuals.fate: Died by end of 2024 - cause not stated ('after the unfortunate death of one of the Talamati Males', 2024-10-29).
individuals.notes: Dec 2023 tension: both young Talamati males survived an attack by the Ntsevu Breakaways in mid-2023 (2023-09-04).

individuals.label: Styx Male (born 2016, Styx/Nkuhuma pair)
individuals.fate: Died 'mysteriously'; the 2021 partnership with the Nkuhuma Male was short-lived after his death (2024-10-29). Year of death not given (after Apr 2021).
individuals.notes: Do not confuse with 'Styx Male (born 2021)'. Cross-agent link.

individuals.label: Styx Male (born 2021, son of an Ndzhenga male)
individuals.birth_note: 'a son of the Ndzhenga males, born in 2021' (2026-07-07)
individuals.fate: Alive Jul 2026 as lone nomad; blonde mane.
individuals.notes: Fought a Kambula male Feb 2025 (killed a young cub, seriously injured an older male) then chased off by his father (2025-02-20). Association with a Kambula/Ntsevu breakaway female for ~2 years (2026-04-02). Gijima Males displaced him from buffalo kill (2025-06-12). Possible coalition partner for the Nkuhuma Breakaway Male (2025-08-04; 2026-07-07).

individuals.label: Skorro Male (Skorro Young Male / Skorro Breakaway Male)
individuals.birth_note: Young adult in 2023; sire's line only
individuals.fate: Last confirmed Jan-Feb 2024; Feb 2026 post notes an unidentified large male at Ximpalapala not Plains Camp (may be him, unknown).
individuals.father_or_sire_label: Orpen Males (born of Nkuhuma Pride, sired by Matimba Males)
individuals.notes: Mated with the Tsalala Female in Nov 2023 (2023-12-11); 2024-02-19 suggested he could be sire of her litter, but 2024-05-28 and 2024-09-03 say the Plains Camp Males are believed to be the fathers. Briefly paired with the Nkuhuma Male (Jan 2024). Lineage: 2023-08-07.

individuals.label: Dark-maned Northern Avoca Male
individuals.birth_note: Born in the Avoca Pride, Timbavati, after the Southern Avoca brothers (b. early 2013): 'younger three brothers' (2024-11-04)
individuals.fate: Not individually dated; one Northern Avoca Male was the last survivor by Dec 2022 and was still alive Jul 2024.
individuals.notes: Separated from his two brothers c.2019/20 and associated 'strictly' with the Talamati lionesses; has a bump/wrist injury in the front right foot (2022-07-25). Whether the single 'Northern Avoca Male' with the Nkuhuma Pride in Jul 2024 is this male is not stated.

individuals.label: Old Avoca Male (the Giraffe Male)
individuals.birth_note: Unknown
individuals.fate: Unknown
offspring_labels: Five male cubs born early 2013 in the Avoca Pride: two became the Southern Avoca Males, three the Northern Avoca Males
individuals.notes: Described as 'the legendary Old Avoca Male, also known as the Giraffe Male' (2024-11-04).

individuals.label: Southern Avoca Male (Kruger/S Avoca coalition)
individuals.birth_note: Born early 2013 in the Avoca Pride of the Timbavati, one of five male cubs (2024-11-04)
individuals.fate: Injured in a clash with the Plains Camp Males c.Nov 2024 and fled north; reappeared weak in the south weeks later (2025-01-16); no later sighting in these posts.
sibling_labels: Southern Avoca brother (killed by Nkuhlu Males)
individuals.notes: Held the Sparta and Sand River Prides with his brother; killed the Piva male leopard and Xidulu female leopard in 2017 (2024-11-04). Lower right canine broken.

individuals.label: Kruger Male (Kruger/S Avoca coalition)
individuals.birth_note: Born late 2013 or early 2014 in the S30 Pride near Skukuza (2024-11-04)
individuals.fate: Alive in May 2025 (mating with the Tsalala Female, 2025-05-25).
sibling_labels: Two S30 brothers (one lost 2016, one died 2021 of hip injury)
individuals.notes: Driven back to a nomadic life by the Mantimahle males after his last brother died (2021). Dark-edged mane. Not seen with the Southern Avoca Male after Dec 2024. Not to be confused with the earlier 'Kruger Male' of 2006 mentioned in 2015-12-14.

individuals.label: Gijima Male (dark-maned, larger)
individuals.birth_note: Born ~2016-2017 in the Greater Kruger (2026-07-07)
individuals.fate: Alive Jul 2026; 'carrying numerous injuries' (2026-07-07).
offspring_labels: Kambula lioness litters (killed late 2025; 8 cubs by Jul 2026)
individuals.notes: Mated with the Tsalala Female (Nov 2025). The Kambula female's 2025 litter was killed by 'the dark-maned Gijima Male' (2025-12-28).

individuals.label: Gijima Male (blonde / light-maned)
individuals.fate: Alive Jul 2026; beaten up by the Nkuhuma Breakaway Male ('badly battered' next morning, 2026-07-07).
individuals.notes: Mated with a Ntsevu lioness (Nov 2025) and both Kambula lionesses (Dec 2025). Crossed the Sand River to confront the Nkuhuma Breakaway Male.

individuals.label: Gijima Male (third brother, deceased)
individuals.birth_note: Same cohort as the two surviving Gijima males (inferred)
individuals.fate: Killed by the four Ndzhenga Males in an altercation in the deep south 'just months after' their Nov 2021 arrival (2025-08-21). Contradicts 2023-06-19, which has the Gijima Males injuring an Ndzhenga male in April 2022.
individuals.notes: Only evidence is the 2025-08-21 sentence; no other post counts three Gijima males.

individuals.label: Ndzhenga Male with side injury (name-giver)
individuals.birth_note: Three of the four males born 2015 (2022-11-10)
individuals.fate: Died 25 May 2023 - body found on Londolozi's eastern boundary; presumed succumbed to old buffalo-horn belly wound (2023-06-19).
sibling_labels: Two N'waswitshaka brothers in the coalition (larger & smaller injury-free males)
individuals.notes: 'Ndzhenga' means thorn in the side, after his buffalo-horn gash with protruding intestine.

individuals.label: Ndzhenga Male from S79 Pride (crooked front left paw)
individuals.birth_note: Unknown (born in S79 Pride, Kruger NP); the three N'waswitshaka males were born 2015
individuals.fate: Died 9 Feb 2023: body found east of the Sand River after a hind-leg injury sustained when caught alone by the Gijima Males (April 2022). 2022-12-14 describes a dislocated back-right knee.
individuals.notes: Front left foot fused at ~45 degrees; unrelated, joined the others during nomadic phase near Skukuza. Unable to keep up with brothers after the injury.

individuals.label: Ndzhenga Male (larger, dark mane, injury-free)
individuals.birth_note: One of three N'waswitshaka males born 2015
individuals.fate: Alive; displaced north by Gijima Males (Nov 2025); Jul 2026 two Ndzhenga males 'from the south' on Londolozi.
offspring_labels: Styx Male (b.2021) - one Ndzhenga male named father
individuals.notes: Largest of the four; 2022-05-18 describes 'the two strongest; one a lot larger than the other and with a darker mane'.

individuals.label: Ndzhenga Male (smaller, injury-free)
individuals.birth_note: One of three N'waswitshaka males born 2015
individuals.fate: Alive; front-paw injury after clash with Black Dam Males Jul 2023 (2023-08-07).
individuals.notes: 2022-12-14: the Ntsevu females are somewhat bigger than him.

individuals.label: Ridge Nose (Nkuhuma Breakaway lioness)
individuals.birth_note: Born around December 2012, littermate of Amber Eyes, sired by Matimba Males (2022-08-10; 2024-07-31)
individuals.fate: Killed in 2024 (with her sister), presumably by the Mhangeni Pride (2024-07-31). Both lionesses were reported killed 'in recent months' as of that post.
offspring_labels: Nkuhuma Breakaway male and/or female (b. 2022; mother is one of the two sisters)
individuals.notes: Identity of 'Ridge Nose' vs 'Amber Eyes' as mother of the 2022 cubs is not specified.

individuals.label: Amber Eyes (Nkuhuma Breakaway lioness)
individuals.birth_note: Born around December 2012, littermate of Ridge Nose (2022-08-10; 2024-07-31)
individuals.fate: Killed in 2024, presumably by the Mhangeni Pride.
individuals.notes: Same as above.

individuals.label: Nkuhuma Breakaway Male (Plains Camp son)
individuals.fate: Alive Jul 2026; wounded the blonde Gijima Male; considered possible coalition partner for Styx Male.
individuals.notes: Plains Camp genetics evident (large frame). Went quiet after the Gijima encounter (2026-07-07). Age quoted 4 in Aug 2025 would imply birth 2021 (small inconsistency).

individuals.label: Nkuhuma Breakaway Female (Plains Camp daughter)
individuals.birth_note: Born 2022 (two cubs, 1 male + 1 female, 2022-08-10)
individuals.fate: Alive Jul 2026; may have helped her brother against a Gijima male (speculative).
individuals.notes: Impressively large for her age (2025-08-04).

individuals.label: Nkuhuma lioness born Dec 2012 (injured hind leg 2020)
individuals.birth_note: Born December 2012, littermate of Ridge Nose/Amber Eyes (2022-08-10)
individuals.fate: Hind-leg injury (2020) with deteriorating condition; last seen ~Jul 2022 'not looking good'; fate not stated.
individuals.father_or_sire_label: Matimba Males (inferred - littermates of the two sired by Matimba)
individuals.notes: 2022-08-10 calls them 'three' Dec-2012 littermates (two + this one).

individuals.label: Nkuhuma subadults born May-Dec 2019 (7: 5 males, 2 females)
individuals.birth_note: Born between May and December 2019 (2022-08-10)
individuals.fate: By Jul 2024 'three of his sons born into the Nkuhuma Pride in 2019 have left their mothers' and accompany the surviving Northern Avoca Male (2024-07-18); others unaccounted.
individuals.notes: Part of the nine cubs reported Mar 2020 (oldest mid-2019, youngest Dec 2019).

individuals.label: Nkuhuma subadults born Apr-Jun 2021 (7: 3 males, 4 females)
individuals.birth_note: Born April-June 2021 (2022-08-10)
individuals.fate: 2024-07-18: pride has three sub-adult females + one sub-adult male (survivors).
individuals.notes: Raised by three mid-2016-born females.

individuals.label: Silver-eye (Talamati lioness, blind in one eye)
individuals.birth_note: One of two females born after mating with the 'Old Nkuhuma Males' c.2007-08; 'around 15 years old' Jul 2022
individuals.fate: Alive Aug 2023, 'possibly the oldest living lion in the Sabi Sand region' (2023-08-07); leads hunts, now often alone.
offspring_labels: Matimba-sired Talamati cubs 2011-2015 (one survivor; mother inferred as Silver-eye and/or her sister)
individuals.notes: Bluish-grey colour in one eye; mated with the Matimba males after the pride returned to the Sabi Sands in 2011.

individuals.label: Silver-eye's sister (Talamati)
individuals.birth_note: Born c.2007 with Silver-eye
individuals.fate: Not individually reported; 'two old females died during the Selati reign' (2015-2019) leaving three lionesses - may be her.
individuals.notes: Inferred from 'two females ... the oldest lionesses in the Talamati Pride' (2022-07-25).

individuals.label: Talamati lioness (sole surviving Matimba daughter)
individuals.birth_note: Born from the Matimba-sired litters of 2011-2015
individuals.fate: Left pride and mated with the Imbali male in 2021 with two Selati daughters ('no longer with the pride', 2022-07-25).
individuals.notes: Part of the 'three Talamati lionesses' who mated with the Imbali male.

individuals.label: Talamati lionesses sired by Selati Males (two)
individuals.birth_note: Born after the Selati takeover (2015+)
individuals.fate: Left the pride and mated with the Imbali male (2021); later fate not stated.

individuals.label: Talamati subadults born early 2019 (9 cubs: 6 F + 3 M)
individuals.birth_note: Born early 2019 to Talamati lionesses (2022-07-25)
individuals.fate: One male + one female sub-adult died 2021; another female sub-adult killed by Plains Camp Males early 2022; leaving 4 females + 2 males. The four ~5-year-old lionesses of 2023 and the two Talamati Young Males are these survivors (inferred).
individuals.notes: The two surviving males became the 'Talamati Young Males' - one died 2024, the other (Talamati Male) joined the Nkumati Coalition.

individuals.label: Imbali Male
individuals.birth_note: Unknown
individuals.fate: Unknown
individuals.notes: In 2021 'sensed that the Dark-maned Northern Avoca Male was alone' and tried to claim the Talamati lionesses; three Talamati lionesses mated with him (2022-07-25).

individuals.label: Tsalala Female (born March 2019)
individuals.birth_note: Born March 2019 (litter of three: one male, two females; 'exactly four years old' on 2023-03-27); mother killed 20 Nov 2021
individuals.fate: Alive Nov 2025 (looked for a mate, second litter lost late 2025).
sibling_labels: Two sisters killed by leopard Aug 2019
individuals.notes: Mating partners listed in posts: Skorro Male (Nov 2023), Plains Camp Males (Dec 2023-Feb 2024; Jan 2025; sired her 2024 and Sept 2025 litters), Kruger Male (May 2025), both Gijima Males (Nov 2025). Primary coverage belongs to the Tsalala agent.

coalitions.name: Plains Camp Males
members: Plains Camp Male (smaller, very dark mane)
coalitions.origin: Origin not stated. First described Sept 2021 as a young coalition (~5 yrs old, born ~2016) moving between Avoca and Birmingham territories; Apr 2021 post speculates unidentified young males might be 'Plains Camp Pride young males' (unconfirmed). Name derived from 'Plains Camp' area (not explained).

sired_litters.mother: Nkuhuma Breakaway lionesses (Ridge Nose / Amber Eyes)
sired_litters.notes: One male + one female cub; their first litter in the Sabi Sand (2024-07-31)
Nine cubs (2023-09-04); ten cubs Jun 2024; three surviving subadults 2026
'have sired cubs with' (2024-07-18); no details
Litter of 3 (two females, one male) found Jul 2024; all lost by Nov 2024
Second litter late Sept 2025 (Singita); lost within a week
Mated Apr 2024; no litter reported

coalitions.territory: Western sector of the Sabi Sand incl. western Londolozi (Sparta/Marthly), pushed east to the causeway/Plaque Rock (Jul-Aug 2024) and north into Nkuhuma territory (Jul 2024); by 2026 'moved further north following the Ximungwe/Bateleur Pride'.
coalitions.status: Dominant in the west 2021-2026; by Jul 2026 under 'considerable pressure' on the Nkumati Coalition but still the largest coalition in the region.
coalitions.notes: Took over the Mhangeni Pride after the Othawa Male's death (2021-22) (2022-09-19). Fought the Ndzhenga Males repeatedly (Aug 2024 chase; Dec 2024 standoff). Chased/attacked the Kruger + Southern Avoca Males (c.Nov-Dec 2024) and the Nkuhuma + Talamati Males (21 Jun 2025); a possible clash with the Gijima Males on the night of 15 Aug 2025 (one Gijima male had a facial gash and one Plains Camp Male limped on a back leg, 2025-08-17; the post does not explicitly name the opponents). Believed (inferred) to have killed the older Tsalala lioness on 20 Nov 2021 (2023-12-11); possible killer of the Tsalala Female's three cubs in Nov 2024 (the 'smaller' male, 2025-01-16) but neighbours say they were not aggressive to the cubs.

coalitions.name: Ndzhenga Males
members: Ndzhenga Male with side injury (name-giver, died 25 May 2023)
Ndzhenga Male from S79 Pride with crooked front left paw (died 9 Feb 2023)
coalitions.origin: Three brothers born 2015 in the N'waswitshaka Pride (Kruger NP, near Skukuza) plus an unrelated fourth male from the S79 Pride (KNP); joined as nomads around Skukuza; seen in Sabi Sand south from ~2020, trailing buffalo into Styx pride territory. Also called 'N'waswitshaka Males' and 'Ndhzenga Coalition'. 'Ndzhenga' = thorn in the side.

sired_litters.notes: Several litters (2022-11-10); Styx Male b.2021 is a son of an Ndzhenga male; one Styx cub killed Dec 2022 by six young males (2022-12-14)
Multiple litters 2022, none survived beyond a few months (2022-11-10)
21-24 cubs; 12-16 remained Jul 2023 (>= 5 F, 8 M); further litters Nov 2023 (3 cubs) and May 2024 (4 cubs) for the Ntsevu (reduced) pride
13 cubs in Mar-May 2024; 8 sub-adult males + 4 females Feb 2025
Six cubs born early-mid 2025, alive Dec 2025
'rating (siring?) new cubs with the Nkuhuma Pride' - inferred (2026-04-04)

coalitions.territory: South-east and central Londolozi along the Sand River (Nov 2021-Nov 2025); airstrip; extended into Mala Mala. From Aug 2025 pushed north; relinquished Londolozi to the Gijima Males (Nov 2025) and followed the Ntsevu/Kambula mothers north; 2026 near Nkuhuma Pride.
coalitions.status: Reduced from four to two (hernia male died 25 May 2023; clubfoot male died 9 Feb 2023). Displaced by the Gijima Males c. Aug-Nov 2025. 2026-07-07: two Ndzhenga males 'from the south' on Londolozi (location inconsistent with northward retreat).
coalitions.notes: Arrived early Nov 2021 'from the south' and ousted the Birmingham Males (last survivor fled west mid-2022). Seven of eleven Birmingham-sired Ntsevu cubs lost. Fought Plains Camp Males (Aug 2024), Black Dam Males (Jul 2023). A 2025-08-21 post says they killed a third Gijima male early in their tenure; 2023-06-19 says the Gijima Males injured the clubfoot Ndzhenga male in April 2022. Unnamed Ndzhenga male climbed a jackalberry tree to steal an impala from the Ximungwe Female leopard (2024-09-10).

coalitions.name: Gijima Males
members: Gijima Male (third; killed by Ndzhenga Males)
coalitions.origin: Born in the Greater Kruger ecosystem ~2016-2017 (2026-07-07). Name 'Gijima' (Shangaan 'run') given by the southern properties due to their very unrelaxed nature on arrival in the Sabi Sand. Originally three males.

sired_litters.notes: Fathers of the pride's cubs (2025-10-08; 2026-04-04)
'protecting new offspring within the Southern Pride' (2025-06-12)
Cubs born Nov 2025 killed by Gijima males (dark-maned male named)
New litters; eight cubs by Jul 2026 (2026-07-26)

coalitions.territory: South Sabi Sand -> from Aug 2025 central Londolozi (airstrip) and for the first time north of the Sand River (9 Nov 2025), exploring into Mala Mala; 2026-09: moving further north while Nwaswitshaka Males hold the south.
coalitions.status: Dominant on Londolozi since Nov 2025, 'the dominant duo'; 2026-07-07 asks how much longer they have (~9-10 years old).
coalitions.notes: Dominant over Styx, Southern and Msuthlu prides (2025-09-22) and took over the Kambula/Ntsevu prides in Nov 2025. Killed a Kambula sub-adult male (Nov 2025). Fought Nkuhuma + Talamati males (Aug 2025 airstrip) and Plains Camp Males (Aug 2025); blonde male beaten by Nkuhuma Breakaway Male in 2026. First reported on Londolozi in Jul 2023 (2023-07-30). Date discrepancy: 2026-04-04 says 'dominant in the Sabi Sands for six years'.

coalitions.name: Northern Avoca Males
coalitions.origin: Three brothers born in the Avoca Pride of the Timbavati, three younger sons of the Old Avoca Male (Giraffe Male); the older two became the Southern Avoca Males. First noted by Londolozi in May 2018 as three new males moving into the northern Sabi Sand (2018-05-16).

sired_litters.notes: Cubs born May-Dec 2019 (5 M, 2 F) and Apr-Jun 2021 (3 M, 4 F); 9 cubs reported Mar 2020 (oldest mid-2019)
Nine cubs (6 F, 3 M); two males and four females survive 2022-23

coalitions.territory: Northern Londolozi (Marthly) and northern Sabi Sand; pushed south across the Sand River into Birmingham territory in 2020-21.
coalitions.status: Whittled from three to one by Dec 2022 (cause not stated); a single Northern Avoca Male remained with the Nkuhuma Pride in Jul 2024.
coalitions.notes: Clash with the Birmingham Males Jun-Jul 2021 left both coalitions injured. Counts vary: 'three brothers, two spend most time together' (2020-09-12) vs 'coalition of two brothers' (2021-06-22).

coalitions.name: Southern Avoca Males
members: Southern Avoca brother (killed by Nkuhlu Males)
coalitions.origin: Two of five male cubs born early 2013 in the Avoca Pride of the Timbavati, sired by the Old Avoca Male; left south while three younger brothers stayed (the Northern Avoca Males).

sired_litters.mother: Sparta Pride and Sand River Prides
sired_litters.notes: no litters described

coalitions.territory: South of Londolozi (Sparta, Sand River prides); visited Londolozi 2017.
coalitions.status: Coalition ended when one brother was killed by the Nkuhlu Males; survivor joined the Kruger Male in Oct 2024.
coalitions.notes: Killed the Piva male leopard and Xidulu female leopard in 2017 (2024-11-04).

coalitions.name: Kruger Male and Southern Avoca Male (nomad coalition)
coalitions.origin: Two unrelated ageing nomads: Kruger Male (S30 Pride near Skukuza, b. late 2013/early 2014, ex-Torchwood Pride) and the Southern Avoca Male (b. early 2013). Appeared on Londolozi early Oct 2024.

sired_litters.notes: Possible killers of one female Tsalala cub (2024-11-05) - unconfirmed

coalitions.territory: North of Sand River then through Londolozi in Oct 2024; chased one Plains Camp Male back into Singita.
coalitions.status: Dissolved within weeks: Plains Camp Males injured the Southern Avoca Male (c. Nov 2024); Kruger Male alone; both seen weak/alone in the south weeks later; Kruger Male mated with the Tsalala Female May 2025.
coalitions.notes: Called 'a union for survival rather than dominance'. Past their prime. Introduced as one of 'Three New Coalitions, One Territory' (2024-10-27) with the Nkuhlu Males and Ntsevu/Kambula Males.

coalitions.name: Nkumati Coalition (Nkuhuma + Talamati Males)
coalitions.origin: Two unrelated males: Nkuhuma Male (born ~2016, Nkuhuma Pride; Birmingham-sired) and the Talamati Male (born early 2019, Talamati Pride; Northern Avoca-sired - inferred). Partnership from 2024 (mid-2024 per 2026-02-12; 'end of 2024' per 2024-10-29); named 'Nkumati Coalition' on 9 Feb 2026. The two bloodlines had split in 2007 (Talamati Pride broke away from Nkuhuma).

sired_litters.notes: Four cubs (2026-02-12; sire stated generally in 2026-07-07)

coalitions.territory: South-west Londolozi / southern part of the western sector (2026) after the Plains Camp Males moved north; earlier (2025) roaming central/south-west Londolozi and the airstrip.
coalitions.status: Active Jul 2026; considered by guides to be under pressure from Plains Camp Males; may expand east.
coalitions.notes: Chased from Kambula Pride by the Ndzhenga Males; attacked by Plains Camp Males on 21 Jun 2025 (Nkuhuma fled, Talamati stood); chased from the airstrip by Gijima Males Aug 2025. Not related by blood ('not brothers'). 2024-01-08: earlier Nkuhuma Male/Skorro Male pairing was short-lived.

coalitions.name: Black Dam Males
coalitions.origin: Origin not stated; first seen May 2023 near the Londolozi airstrip.
coalitions.territory: Northern Londolozi/Marthly, crossing south of the Sand River; claimed the former Northern Avoca territory and the Nkuhuma Pride.
coalitions.status: 'Upped and left the northern stretches' by Jul 2024 (2024-07-18).
coalitions.notes: Injured the smaller Ndzhenga male's front paw (Jul 2023). Tried to run down the Talamati Young Males. They had earlier driven the Ntsevu Breakaway Males south (2023-09-27).

coalitions.name: Nwaswitshaka Males
coalitions.origin: Four young brothers 'descending from the same Kruger National Park pride' (N'waswitshaka) as the Ndzhenga Males; distantly related.
coalitions.territory: South of the Gijima territory, southern Londolozi in 2026.
coalitions.status: Newest coalition on Londolozi (2026-07-07); associating and mating with Msuthlu Pride females (2026-09-01).
coalitions.notes: Expected by one ranger to be 'next' to rule; fought/attempted to confront young Msuthlu male in Aug-Sep 2026.

coalitions.name: Talamati Young Males
coalitions.origin: Two surviving male sub-adults from the nine cubs born early 2019 to the Talamati Pride, sired by the Northern Avoca Males (inferred identity of these two).
coalitions.status: One died by end 2024; survivor joined Nkuhuma Male (Nkumati Coalition).
coalitions.notes: Survived attack by Ntsevu Breakaways (mid-2023) and harassment by Black Dam Males.

coalitions.name: Ntsevu Breakaway Males (Kambula Males) - stub
coalitions.origin: Four sub-adult males from the Ntsevu Pride (Birmingham-sired 2018-19 litters) that left after the Ndzhenga takeover; covered by the Ntsevu/Kambula agent.
coalitions.territory: South-west Londolozi; Manyeleti/Nkuhuma area in late 2024; back in the south by 2025.
coalitions.status: Active; mated with Nkuhuma Pride lionesses 2024 (2024-09-09).
coalitions.notes: Link stub. Introduced as one of 'Three New Coalitions, One Territory' (2024-10-27).

coalitions.name: Nkuhlu Males (stub)
coalitions.origin: Not stated; 'the only coalition of six that we know of' (2024-03-17) from the south; named in 2024-10-27 as moving into Ndzhenga territory.
coalitions.status: Active 2024; killed a Southern Avoca brother (2024-11-04); killed a Msuthlu sub-adult late 2025 (2026-04-04).

coalitions.origin: Born 2000 (3) and 2002 (3) (2024-06-10); fathered the four original Mhangeni lionesses with the Tsalala Sisters.

Nkuhuma Male (b.~2016) described as Birmingham-sired

open_questions: SCOPE NOTE: Several items in the brief are leopards or cheetahs, not lions, and were not entered as lion data: Three Rivers Duo / Three Rivers Female / Three Rivers Young Male (leopards, 2023-07-09, 2025-01-19), Nkoveni Female and her cubs/'Nkoveni Trio'/'Nkoveni duo' (leopards; the 2024-11-17 'Kambula Pride ambush the Nkoveni Trio' post is a Nkoveni Young Female leopard killed by the Kambula lions), Xinkhova Female (leopard), Flat Rock Male (leopard, 2022-10-24), Ximungwe Female/Young Male (leopards). Only the lion 'Ximungwe Pride' (renamed Bateleur Pride) is recorded.

Formation date of the Mhangeni Pride is inconsistent: 2010 (Majingilane arrival, several posts), Jan 2012 (flood; 2021-12-07), 'newly-named Mhangeni pride' in Sept 2013 (2016-09-03), and 'formed in 2013' (2016-10-10). Name origin ('Meaning Aloe') only in 2021-12-07.

Birth year of the four Mhangeni founders: 2009 (2021-12-07, 2022-09-19, 2024-06-10) vs 2008 and 'eleven years old' (2019-12-02). Also whether they were daughters of the Tailless Female (2016-04-30 'Tailless female's daughters') or her granddaughters (2017-05-01/2021-12-07/2022-01-10).
Original Tailless Female's death (2013): 2021-12-07 states she was mauled by the Mhangeni females; 2018-05-20 says 'suspected'.
Fate of the two original (2009-born) Mhangeni lionesses: still alive Jun 2024 (aged 15; one toothless); the Feb 2026 pride composition lists no 2009-born adult. No death reported.

Mhangeni pride litter counts differ: 12 cubs 'between them' (Sept 2016) with 9M/3F (2018-09-29); 4 cubs of one lioness seen Sept 2018; cubs from Othawa Male counted as 2, then 3, then 'one 2021-born survivor'; Plains-Camp cubs 9 (2023), 10 (2024), 3 survivors (2026).
Paternity of the four Mhangeni cubs born Nov 2025 is implied (Nkumati Coalition) in 2026-02-12 and stated generally in 2026-07-07, but never explicit.

Othawa Male: age in Dec 2019 given as ~7 (2019-12-02) but he was born ~early 2015 (2018-09-17: 3.5 yrs, 2021-01-09: 5 yrs). Cause of death: killed by Birmingham Males (2024-08-05, 2024-08-26) vs 'recently triumphant over' (2021-06-22). Exact date of death 2021 unknown.

Plains Camp Males' origin (natal pride) is never stated; Apr 2021 post only speculates 'Plains Camp Pride young males'. Which Plains Camp male limped in Aug 2025 or is the 'smaller' male blamed for the Tsalala cubs is not specified for individuals.

Gijima Males: timeline conflict. 2023-06-19 says they injured a lone Ndzhenga male in April 2022; 2025-08-21 says the Ndzhenga Males killed a third Gijima male 'just months after' arriving (Nov 2021); 2026-04-04 says they have been dominant in the Sabi Sands for six years; first Londolozi sighting is Jul 2023. Only the 2025-08-21 post mentions a third Gijima male.
Ndzhenga Males in 2026: 2026-04-04 says they pushed north and are siring Nkuhuma cubs; 2026-07-07 says two Ndzhenga males 'from the south' ventured onto Londolozi.

Two different 'Styx Male' individuals: (a) Styx young male b.2016 who paired with the Nkuhuma Male and 'mysteriously died'; (b) Styx Male b.2021, son of an Ndzhenga male (alive 2026). Posts do not always distinguish them.
Nkuhuma Male's father: 'sired by the Birmingham Males, so either his son or nephew' (2022-08-10) vs 'his late father, the Birmingham Male' (2023-09-04). Which Birmingham male is unstated.

Matimba chronology: Matimba Males are credited with siring Nkuhuma lionesses born Dec 2012 (2024-07-31) and Talamati cubs from 2011, but the Matimba pair first appeared on Londolozi in Sept 2015 (2017-03-02) and were two of an original coalition of six from the Manyeleti; whether 2011-2012 siring is by the same males is unclear.

The Talamati young male seen with the Mhangeni breakaways in 2016 (Matimba-sired) is not linked to the later Talamati cohort (born 2019, Northern Avoca-sired). The Talamati Males (2) vs 'one of the Talamati Young Males' that died in 2024: cause/date not stated. 2022-07-25 calls Talamati 'the newest pride' although Talamati males were noted from 2016.

Msuthlu Pride: 2025-10-05 says it was 'formerly the Talamati Breakaway Pride'; 2026-04-04 says first encountered 2022 in the north, 4 adult females with 14 lions, sired by Gijima Males. How/when the Talamati Breakaway formed and whether its females are the four ~5-year-old Talamati lionesses of 2023 is not stated (speculation only).

Nkuhuma Breakaway male: described as '4 years old' in Aug 2025 (2025-08-04) and in Jul 2026 (2026-07-07) with birth year 2022; mother (Ridge Nose or Amber Eyes) and which of the pair raised the cubs not specified. The adult lionesses' death is dated only to 'recent months' before Jul 2024 and attributed 'presumably' to the Mhangeni Pride.

Northern Avoca Males: counts conflict (three brothers with two together and one apart in Sept 2020; 'coalition of two brothers' Jun 2021; one survivor by Dec 2022); the cause and dates of the brothers' deaths are not given; identity of the dark-maned male with the Talamati vs the single survivor in 2024.
Skorro Male (Skorro Young/Breakaway Male): mother and exact age unknown; no sighting after Feb 2024 in these posts. The unidentified large male at Ximpalapala Koppie on 2026-02-08 was not identified.
Fate of the Kruger + Southern Avoca coalition after Jan 2025: the Southern Avoca Male appears last as 'very weak' in the south (2025-01-16).

Cross-agent contradiction noted: 2021-12-07 says the three 2014 Tsalala young males were electrocuted in Kruger after dispersing in Aug 2017, but 2018 posts (2018-05-16, 2018-05-30) show the three males alive with the Tailless female in 2018. Tailless/Tailed Tsalala lioness deaths, Sparta, Ntsevu and Kambula details belong to other agents.

2016-11-29 says the Mhangeni Breakaway cubs (born late 2016) were 'not fathered by the Majingilane'; 2017-01-09 says the Matimba males are believed to be the fathers; 2017-03-02 and 2017-04-29 imply Matshipiri/Matimba matings; actual sire of the Ntsevu first litters is not confirmed.
Date discrepancy: the Ntsevu Breakaway Pride is said to have formed from the 2013 litter 'in 2015' (2024-06-10) but was renamed in April 2017 (2017-04-29).
